criteria.requirement: Derive and validate the current approved managed assignment before any dispatch.
Require explicit executor/model, permission, consent and limit profiles.
Exercise real pinned OpenCode tools through durable managed execution against a local fake endpoint.
Keep visible observations bounded, ordered, redacted and reconnectable.
Confirm active owned resources stop before acknowledging pause or stop.
Preserve control and project ownership through races, lease loss and uncertain outcomes.
Resume from fresh validated context without losing owner edits or resetting usage.
Recover crashes and lost acknowledgements without replaying unknown effects.
Require real current core verification and task recording after candidate execution.
Keep supervisor credentials out of check processes, observations and artifacts.
Expose the managed terminal journey through shared validated services and installed CLI tests.
Preserve runtime/package/site/tooling/catalog/security gates and existing client/fixture behavior.
